column1: # Hand-curated motif overrides for the JAK1 bundle.
# This bundle holds two DIFFERENT proteins, so every row is scoped to its structure with a
# pdb_id column. Without that, JAK1's His885 and JAK2's Asn859 would each be stamped onto
# the other structure at the same residue number, which would be nonsense: these are not
# equivalent positions, they are unrelated residues of two different sequences.
# THE NUMBERS HERE ARE THE DEPOSITED ONES, WHICH ARE NOT THE PAPER'S. The paper names the
# hinge Glu930 and Leu932 while discussing both isoforms. That is correct for JAK2 (10PJ
# 930 GLU, 932 LEU) and wrong for JAK1: in 10PI residue 930 is ARG, and the JAK1 hinge is
# 957 GLU, 958 PHE, 959 LEU, against JAK2's 930 GLU, 931 TYR, 932 LEU. PLIP finds the
# ligand hydrogen bonding LEU959 in 10PI, which is the same contact the paper calls Leu932.
# The offset is +27 at the hinge and +26 at the P-loop (JAK1 His885 = JAK2 Asn859, JAK1
# Phe886 = JAK2 Phe860), so no single offset converts one numbering into the other.
# Likewise the JAK1 DFG aspartate is Asp1021 (1021 ASP, 1022 PHE, 1023 GLY), not Asp1042:
# 1042 is an unrelated aspartate. See ISSUES.md item 4.
# Source: Zhuo et al. 2026, Figure 4 and the accompanying selectivity discussion, with every
# residue number checked against the deposited coordinates.
